beginner.summary: For Python developers who are new to CrewAI. Covers installing the crewai CLI with uv, scaffolding a crew, YAML-driven agents and tasks, LLM configuration including local models, running crews with kickoff and reading CrewOutput, the sequential and hierarchical processes, built-in and custom tools, structured outputs, delegation, memory, knowledge sources, a first Flow, debugging with replay, token and cost tracking, and a research and report crew capstone.
prerequisites: Writes Python programs with functions, classes and virtual environments
Has an API key for an LLM provider or can run a local model with Ollama
Uses a terminal and Git, and has a laptop with Python installed and rights to install uv
outcomes: Scaffold, configure and run a CrewAI crew from YAML and Python
Design agents, tasks, tools and processes that return typed, validated outputs
Add memory, knowledge and delegation and explain what each costs
Debug runs with logs and replay and report token usage and cost per run

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a basic crew. Covers input templating, prompt design, robust tools, MCP servers, retrieval tools, knowledge and memory tuning, task guardrails, conditional tasks and human input, planning and reasoning, Flows with routers and persisted state, crews inside flows, code execution sandboxes, testing and training, tracing with Langfuse or Phoenix, event listeners, a FastAPI service and a triage system capstone.
prerequisites: Has built and run at least one CrewAI crew with tools and structured outputs
Writes tests with pytest and uses Git and a CI service
Understands REST APIs, JSON and basic Docker commands
outcomes: Orchestrate crews with Flows using routing, parallel steps and persisted state
Make agents reliable with guardrails, tests, training and tuned knowledge and memory
Trace and measure runs with OpenTelemetry tools and event listeners
Serve a crew as a secured asynchronous API

advanced.summary: For engineers who run CrewAI in production. Covers production architecture, custom manager agents, flow patterns such as fan-out and sagas, approval gates, custom LLM classes with failover, context and token budgets, custom memory and knowledge backends, tool packages, evaluation with golden sets and judges, security against prompt injection, reliability engineering, cost optimisation, deployment to CrewAI AMP and to Kubernetes, observability, governance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and a multi-crew platform capstone.
prerequisites: Has built Flow-based CrewAI applications with tests and tracing
Knows Docker, Kubernetes basics and a metrics tool such as Prometheus
Understands authentication, secrets handling and queue-based processing
outcomes: Design and operate multi-tenant CrewAI systems with defined reliability and cost targets
Build evaluation, security and governance controls that gate releases
Deploy crews to managed and self-hosted platforms with metrics, alerts and runbooks
Diagnose agent failures and plan safe upgrades
